name: interpret
role: command interpreter; stdcall (vector*, &nwords, text*, &nbytes, &status)

name: engine_init
role: start-up: PREF.DAT, WSCORE.DAT, symbol library

name: draw_items
role: draws every item: page frame, then for each item copies its words into P(), calls draw_item, flushes points

name: index_items
role: rebuilds ITEM_PTR0 and the item count from the length words

name: load_item_header
role: LOAD_I -> LOAD_W, LOAD_LEN, LOAD_CODE, LOAD_STAFF, LOAD_P3

name: draw_item
role: IP(k) = INT(P(k)); item_position; switch on code 1..18

name: item_position
role: X_POS = 150 * P3, Y_POS = STAFF_Y(staff) + P4 * 7 * STEP

name: draw_staff
role: code 8

name: draw_staff_number
role: screen-only staff number text left of the staff

name: staff_p4_error
role: draw_staff when P4 >= 1000: formats an error message, draws nothing

name: draw_page_frame
role: green page outline per PAPER, drawn as a code-12 box

name: fit_view
role: draws everything, takes the bounding box of the output, sets VIEW_DY = max y + 3000

name: flush_points
role: COLOR from P26, then emit_points

name: emit_points
role: point buffer -> vector output (x + VIEW_DX, y - VIEW_DY, colour | pen << 24)

name: add_point
role: add_point(&x, &y, &pen): appends INT(x), INT(y), pen to the point buffer

name: add_segment
role: add_segment(&x0, &y0, &x1, &y1): two points, pens 1 and 0

name: amod
role: amod(&x, &y) = x - INT(x / y) * y (Fortran AMOD)

name: push_words
role: push_words(&n, a): saves n words on an internal stack

name: pop_words
role: pop_words(&n, a): restores them

name: draw_barline
role: code 14 (types 0-2 verified, others read)

name: staff_level_y
role: staff_level_y(&v) = f32(STAFF_Y(CUR_STAFF) + v*7*STAFF_STEP(CUR_STAFF))

name: barline_stroke
role: vertical stroke at the bar x from y_bot to y_top

name: barline_dots
role: repeat dots (code-12 boxes) on every spanned staff

name: barline_bracket
role: curved bracket ends (type 9)

name: barline_brace
role: brace (type 8) via the clef routine, symbol 5

name: barline_gap
role: P18/P19 gap in the bar

name: draw_note
role: code 1

name: draw_rest
role: code 2

name: draw_clef
role: code 3

name: draw_line
role: code 4; also dashed barlines

name: draw_slur
role: code 5

name: draw_beam
role: code 6

name: draw_code7
role: code 7: trills, ottava, pedal

name: draw_symbol
role: codes 9, 11, 13

name: draw_number
role: code 10; also staff numbers

name: draw_box_accordion
role: code 12 with P5 = 10: accordion register symbol (impl-symbols)

name: draw_box_guitar
role: code 12 with P5 < 0: guitar chord grid from GUITAR.DAT (loader 0x430EC0, lookup 0x4A07B1; impl-symbols)

name: draw_box
role: code 12 with P5 in {0, 1, 3}

name: draw_box_other
role: code 12, other P5

name: draw_eps
role: code 15

name: draw_text
role: code 16

name: draw_keysig
role: code 17

name: draw_meter
role: code 18

name: redraw
role: fit_view then draw_items

name: cmd_get
role: G command (load and display)

name: box_outline
role: closed rectangle polyline from the corner globals 0x1F93E60..0x1F93E7C (code-12 boxes, page frame)

name: note_ledger_lines
role: ledger lines of a note (draw_note, when P4 < 2 or > 12, or P30)

name: note_head
role: note head, via draw_clef/draw_symbol

name: note_tails
role: tails (flags), IP9 % 10, via draw_clef/draw_symbol

name: note_accidental
role: accidental, IP5 % 10

name: note_stem
role: stem, when (IP5 % 100) / 10 != 0

name: note_marks
role: marks (P11)

name: note_special_head
role: IP6 < -2 except -3 and -20..-39

name: load_symbol_library
role: builds lbNNNN.drw and reads it; 'Not found' dialog if missing

name: input_rhythm_spacing
role: IN pass 2: rhythms and horizontal spacing (input.md)

name: input_min_gap
role: IN: minimum gap of 3 after pass 2 (input.md)

name: input_store_items
role: IN: writes the work table into the item store

name: input_pass
role: IN: parse one pass text and dispatch on the pass number

name: input_rhythm_value
role: IN: decode one rhythm value (dur, type, dots, tails)

name: input_pitches
role: IN pass 1: work table from pitches

name: input_main
role: IN main routine

name: input_range_dialog
role: IN range dialog: IP5 begin, IP6 end, IP7 spacing staff

name: cmd_I
role: commands starting with I: I n (edit item n), II, IN (staged input); also entered after item creation

name: edit_params
role: edit mode: parameter pairs p v, relative and transfer forms (commands.md)

name: edit_letters
role: edit mode: letter commands (/p relative, R/L/U/D moves, accidentals, ...)

name: create_by_mnemonic
role: creates an item from a three-letter mnemonic of the table at 0x7911EC (NOT, RES, CLE, ...)

name: cmd_lineup
role: LJ/LI/J: prompts for the system

name: lineup_answer
role: LJ/LI/J: takes the staff answer or box, confirms, runs

name: lineup_pass
role: LJ/LI/J main pass

name: ask_source_box
role: asks 'Source Box O.K.?' through the yes/no callback 0x595CD0

name: drag_move
role: mouse drag (~v/~s/~t): new P3/P4 into the edit buffer (editing.md)

name: select_nearest
role: click selection: nearest item anchor (editing.md)

name: region_select
role: drag rectangle to an x range and staff range

name: text_parse
role: code 16 parser (text.md, by impl-text)

name: text_emit_char
role: writes one text record string (text.md)

name: text_record_header
role: text record header per font change (text.md)

name: load_font_metrics
role: loads fontlib/FMnn.FMT (text.md)

name: text_rotate
role: rotates text positions by P9 (display.md, text.md)

name: read_prefs
role: parses scorlib/PREF.DAT (prefs.md)

name: anint
role: Fortran ANINT: x +/- 0.5 in f64, chopped (numerics.md)

name: read_user_symbols
role: code 11: reads KH (Fortran unformatted) symbol files (impl-symbols)

name: load_guitar_dat
role: reads scorlib/GUITAR.DAT chord dictionary (impl-symbols)

name: sort_items
role: sort: P3 to 1/100, order by staff, P3, code > 2, P4 (layout.md §2)

name: staff_events
role: lineup: events (x, duration or -code) of one staff (layout.md §3)

name: shortest_open_value
role: lineup: event duration = smallest open value, the rest carried over

name: lineup
role: LI core: anchors, events per staff, merges, spacing, apply (layout.md §4)

name: merge_durations
role: lineup: split master durations at a new staff's onsets

name: lineup_spacing
role: lineup: d**log2(1.5) spacing and marker widths (layout.md §5)

name: lineup_apply
role: lineup: per-staff segment mapping with +1000 parking, clefs placed (layout.md §6)

name: lineup_align
role: lineup: one staff's events against the master list

name: select_items
role: selects item parameters in an x and staff range (globals 0x1FBB860..87C) into the list at 0x20492A4

name: move_selected
role: moves the selected parameters: shift, or linear map (mode < 0)

name: lineup_others
role: lineup: interpolates x parameters of codes 4-7, 9-13, 15, 16 between anchors (layout.md §7)

name: interpolate_x
role: lineup: one parameter between its two anchors

name: place_grace_notes
role: lineup: grace notes (P7 >= 64) placed before their main notes (layout.md §9)

name: justify
role: J: columns per staff, merge, redistribution (layout.md §10)

name: justify_columns
role: J: left/right space needs of the columns of one staff

name: justify_distribute
role: J: takes the needed space from the free space

name: justify_split_gap
role: J: proportional share of a gap's need when another staff splits it

name: justify_stretch
role: J: stretches the selected values inside one gap

name: justify_shift
role: J: shifts the selected values at or right of x

name: barline_widths
role: J: left/right needs of a barline by P5

name: rest_widths
role: J: left/right needs of a rest

name: key_widths
role: J: left/right needs of a key signature

name: meter_widths
role: J: left/right needs of a meter

name: load_p_array
role: J: copies P3..P14 of an item into the P array at 0x1C58924

name: grace_fit
role: lineup: how much of its width a grace group may keep

name: grace_widths
role: lineup: left/right widths of grace notes and their anchors
